mapper.select: SELECT ATTEMPT_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, CODE_VERSION, FAIL_COUNT, LOCKED_UNTIL, VERIFIED_YN, VERIFIED_AT, LAST_ATTEMPT_AT FROM JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT ( ATTEMPT_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, CODE_VERSION, FAIL_COUNT, VERIFIED_YN, LAST_ATTEMPT_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{codeVersion}, 0, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT SET FAIL_COUNT = FAIL_COUNT + 1, LOCKED_UNTIL = CASE WHEN FAIL_COUNT + 1 >= 5 THEN SYSDATE + (15 / 1440) ELSE LOCKED_UNTIL END, LAST_ATTEMPT_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND (LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL OR LOCKED_UNTIL <= SYSDATE)

UPDATE JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT SET VERIFIED_YN = 'Y', VERIFIED_AT = SYSDATE, FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_ATTEMPT_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND (LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL OR LOCKED_UNTIL <= SYSDATE)
UPDATE JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT SET FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_ATTEMPT_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND LOCKED_UNTIL <= SYSDATE AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N'

SELECT JOIN_CODE_VERSION FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND VISIBILITY = 'PRIVATE' AND JOIN_CODE_ENC IS NOT NULL
SELECT JOIN_CODE_ENC, JOIN_CODE_KEY_VER, JOIN_CODE_VERSION, JOIN_CODE_ISSUED_AT FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND VISIBILITY = 'PRIVATE' AND JOIN_CODE_ENC IS NOT NULL
